body.name: Canonical literal and label encoding
body.construction: Order \(\mathrm{LIT}\) lexicographically after forming the disjoint union of action-value literals \(\{(a,x):a\in\mathcal A,\ x\text{ is catalogued for }a\}\) and request literals \(\{(j,v,x):j\in[k],\ v\text{ occurs in the transformed ancestry requested by }C_j,\ x\in\mathfrak X_v\}\). Thus \( |\mathrm{LIT}|\le d\bigl(|\mathcal A|+\sum_{j=1}^{k}|\{v:v\text{ occurs in that transformed ancestry of }C_j\}|\bigr)\), and every \(\ell\) is represented by exactly \( |\mathrm{LIT}|\) bits. Reject a label if it asserts two values for one indexed endpoint, mentions a literal absent from \(\mathrm{LIT}\), or assigns a value not allowed by the catalogue.
